claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: incapacitated
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The failure branch applies the Incapacitated condition. The Condition type only contains 'prone'. Encoding the failure branch requires widening Condition to include 'incapacitated'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the Incapacitated condition until you finish a Long Rest.
